name: @mattskilly/idiom
stderr:
Usage: idiom [options] [command]

A repo-native design acceptance loop for product UI

Start here:
  idiom init                     scaffold PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md and .idiom, then
                                 hand setup to your coding agent
  idiom init --validate          confirm setup is done: prints ready, or the
                                 first problem and its fix
  idiom check <flow>             capture the flow and gate new findings
  idiom fix / idiom decide       repair findings with your agent, or record
                                 accept and reject decisions

Options:
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  --project <dir>                target project directory
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Setup:
  init [options]                 scaffold PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, and .idiom
                                 without data loss
  validate [flow]                validate project configuration and flow
                                 manifests
  doctor [options] [flow]        boot the application server once and diagnose
                                 why a run could not start
  reference                      manage visual references and anti-references
  design                         Configure intended designs (HTML, images or
                                 Figma frames)

Daily loop:
  check [options] [flow]         capture and check for regressions; initialize
                                 clean HEAD once, then gate new findings
  digest [options] [flow]        short summary of the latest run compared with
                                 the previous complete run
  nightly [options] [flows...]   check every flow against its baseline and file
                                 new findings as triage tickets
  review [options] [flow]        review a captured flow, or a single page with
                                 --page, with deterministic and model critique
  fix [options] <flow>           repair deterministic findings with your coding
                                 agent and calibrated verification
  verify [options] <flow>        verify embedded findings with offline recapture
                                 evidence
  capture [options] <flow>       capture every state and viewport in a flow
  report [runId]                 open a review or verify HTML report in the
                                 default browser
  compare [options] <flow>       write before/after composites for tuples that
                                 changed between two stored captures

Judgment and decisions:
  decide [options] [finding]     record accept or reject decisions for reviewed
                                 findings, or acknowledge one tracked elsewhere
  ruling [options]               record a reviewed design ruling or explicit
                                 no-rule outcome
  learn [options] [observation]  record, list, cover, or export a human-found
                                 miss

Briefs:
  brief [options] [request]      before a UI ticket: triage the design decision,
                                 plan the research, record the brief, ask, and
                                 decide

Explore and inspect:
  quick [options] <url...>       review explicit public URLs without Idiom
                                 configuration
  sweep [options] [flow]         capture, run every deterministic check, then a
                                 per-surface model sweep with crops and measured
                                 geometry
  coverage [options]             list the app's routes that no flow captures, or
                                 (--states) which states each flow's latest
                                 capture observed
  explore [options] [flow]       explore three rendered design directions for
                                 one flow state
  bisect [options] <finding>     find the commit that introduced a finding by
                                 capturing its state across its first-seen range
  system [options]
